name: cheetahclaws-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is CheetahClaws, a terminal AI coding agent with a multi-provider agent loop. This task
covers its agent harness core: the permission modes of the agent loop, configuration, the tool registry, context
compaction, API error classification, the circuit breaker, token and cost budgets, session storage,
system-prompt context, the auxiliary model, the built-in tools (files, shell, notebook, web and the rest of the tools
package), task management, persistent memory, skills, checkpoints, plugins and the core slash commands.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is these Python modules of the cheetahclaws package: cheetahclaws/agent.py, cheetahclaws/auxiliary.py, cheetahclaws/circuit_breaker.py, cheetahclaws/compaction.py, cheetahclaws/config.py, cheetahclaws/context.py, cheetahclaws/error_classifier.py, cheetahclaws/quota.py, cheetahclaws/session_store.py, cheetahclaws/skills.py and cheetahclaws/tool_registry.py; every module in cheetahclaws/checkpoint/, cheetahclaws/memory/, cheetahclaws/plugin/, cheetahclaws/skill/, cheetahclaws/task/ and cheetahclaws/tools/; and cheetahclaws/commands/__init__.py, cheetahclaws/commands/advanced.py, cheetahclaws/commands/checkpoint_plan.py, cheetahclaws/commands/config_cmd.py, cheetahclaws/commands/core.py, cheetahclaws/commands/session.py and cheetahclaws/commands/workspace_cmd.py. Together with them, the documentation pages docs/guides/reference.md, docs/guides/ex
